_comment: Tape markers lifted from the PDF margin column of 108_truth.txt.
`tape_seconds` is time WITHIN that tape, not within the audio file: the fixture
does not start at a tape boundary, so the offset from tape time to media time is
unknown and must be FIT, never assumed.
Fit media_time = slope * tape_seconds + offset over the Tape III anchors alone.
Tape IV restarts its clock and needs its own offset -- do not pool the two.
The slope is the useful part: it should come out at 1.0. A slope materially off 1.0
means decoded audio runs fast or slow, which indicts the resampler rather than the
decoder, and would otherwise show up as a diffuse WER penalty with no obvious cause.
`following_text` locates the anchor in a word stream; it is the speech the marker
sits beside in the two-column layout.
